resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief lists the tower as standing; the Register's 2020 visitor says it is no longer maintained. Kept as standing because the visitor says the tower sits outside Mountain View, and the no-maintenance point is carried in status_note.

notes_for_editor: No tower height appears in the sources read, so height_m is not set. No staffing or fire history found. No access level set; the Register gives no access information. Standing status rests on the September 2020 visit only. Brief's agency (Arkansas Forestry Commission) is supported by both sources. Elevation 1,560 ft is recorded in the story, not as a facts key.
